commands.collection:
"""Trusted operator collector; execute only inside the disposable VM."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import datetime
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import time

APP = Path('/vercel/evaluation/rea')
OUT = Path('/vercel/output')
ROOT = Path('/var/lib/rea-controller')
done = json.loads((OUT/'janitor-final-validation.done.json').read_text())
assert done == {'catalogueExit':0,'janitorExit':1,'negativeGateExit':1}, done
catalogue = json.loads((OUT/'controller-accepted-final.json').read_text())
regressions = json.loads((OUT/'janitor-acceptance.json').read_text())
negative = json.loads((OUT/'controller-negative-gate.json').read_text())
assert catalogue['summary'] == {'PASS':20,'FAIL':0,'NOT_TESTED':8}
assert len(catalogue['cases']) == 28
assert regressions['summary'] == {'PASS':9,'FAIL':1,'NOT_TESTED':0}, regressions['summary']
assert [c['id'] for c in regressions['cases'] if c['status']=='FAIL'] == ['JR-09']
assert (Path(negative['statePath'])/'launch-counter').read_text() == '0'
retention = json.loads((OUT/'janitor-loss-retention-observation.json').read_text())
assert any(c['rawIntentsPastDeadline'] for c in retention)
assert all(c['blocked'] for c in retention)

def processes():
    found = []
    names = [str(APP/'experiments/execution-controller'/name) for name in ['controller.py','worker.py']]
    for path in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not path.name.isdecimal():
            continue
        try:
            args = (path/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
            if any(name.encode() in args for name in names):
                found.append(int(path.name))
        except OSError:
            pass
    return found

until = time.monotonic()+35
while processes() and time.monotonic()<until:
    time.sleep(0.2)
remaining = processes()
assert not remaining, remaining
groups = [str(p) for p in Path('/sys/fs/cgroup').glob('rea-eval-*')]
assert not groups, groups
uid_workers = []
for path in Path('/proc').iterdir():
    if not path.name.isdecimal():
        continue
    try:
        if (path/'status').stat().st_uid == 1001:
            uid_workers.append(int(path.name))
    except OSError:
        pass
assert not uid_workers, uid_workers

stores = []
final_state = Path(catalogue['statePath'])
for state in sorted(ROOT.iterdir()):
    if not state.is_dir() or not (state/'state.db').exists():
        continue
    with sqlite3.connect(f'file:{state}/state.db?mode=ro',uri=True) as db:
        rows = {t:db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM '+t).fetchone()[0] for t in ['requests','decisions','audit']}
        raw = db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE intent IS NOT NULL AND raw_until<?',(time.time(),)).fetchone()[0]
        expired = db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE audit_until<?',(time.time(),)).fetchone()[0]
    handles = list((state/'runs').iterdir())
    assert not handles, str(state)
    if state == final_state or state == Path(negative['statePath']):
        assert all(v==0 for v in rows.values()), (str(state),rows)
    log = state/'janitor.log'
    stores.append({'state':str(state),'rowsBeforeOperatorDisposal':rows,
                   'rawIntentsPastDeadline':raw,'requestsPastAuditDeadline':expired,
                   'rawRunHandles':0,'blocked':(state/'blocked').exists(),
                   'privateJanitorDiagnosticBytes':log.stat().st_size if log.exists() else 0,
                   'janitorFailureCodes':[s for s in log.read_text().splitlines() if s.startswith('RETENTION_FAILURE ')] if log.exists() else [],
                   'expiryOutcome':'FAILED_OPERATOR_DISPOSAL_REQUIRED' if any(rows.values()) else 'EMPTY_AT_INSPECTION'})

source = {}
for p in sorted((APP/'experiments/execution-controller').iterdir()):
    if p.is_file():
        source[str(p.relative_to(APP))] = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for name in ['package.json','package-lock.json','LICENSE']:
    source[name] = hashlib.sha256((APP/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','--','src','tests','.github','package.json','package-lock.json','LICENSE'],cwd=APP,text=True)==''
registry_hash = hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'registry.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
debug = OUT/'controller-private-debug.log'
debug_existed = debug.exists()
debug.unlink(missing_ok=True)
shutil.rmtree(ROOT)
sockets = [Path('/run/rea-controller.sock'),*Path('/run').glob('rea-jr-*.sock')]
for p in sockets:
    p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
Path('/run/rea-evaluation-vm').unlink(missing_ok=True)
assert not ROOT.exists() and not debug.exists()
assert not any(p.exists() for p in sockets)

trials=[]
for name in ['controller-catalogue-before-atomic-fix','controller-catalogue-blocked-trial','controller-catalogue-diagnostic-trial','janitor-before-atomic-fix','janitor-pre-transaction-change']:
    p=OUT/(name+'.json')
    if p.exists():
        d=json.loads(p.read_text())
        trials.append({'name':name,'summary':d['summary'],
                       'failures':[{'id':c['id'],'errorType':c.get('errorType'),'diagnostic':c.get('diagnostic')} for c in d['cases'] if c['status']=='FAIL']})

record = {
    'timestamp':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'baseline':catalogue['baseline'],
    'catalogue':catalogue,'janitorRegressions':regressions,
    'retentionAfterStorageOwnerLoss':{'status':'FAIL','observations':retention,
        'cause':'No surviving expiry owner when janitor dies; a blocked admission profile does not delete pending intent/audit.',
        'remediation':'Define independent storage ownership and deadline enforcement; revalidate loss, restart and cleanup-failure paths before enabling the profile.'},
    'checks':{'finalExits':done,'pythonCompile':'PASS, four Python source files',
        'mjsFormat':(OUT/'controller-format-check.log').read_text(),
        'mjsLint':(OUT/'controller-lint.log').read_text(),
        'parentBuildExit':(OUT/'build.exit').read_text().strip(),
        'negativeGate':{'expectedExit':1,'actualExit':1,'actualLaunches':0,'scope':'Deliberately disallowed operator registry; does not count as an acceptance failure.'}},
    'logs':{'catalogue':(OUT/'controller-acceptance-final.log').read_text(),
            'janitor':(OUT/'janitor-acceptance.log').read_text(),
            'parentBuild':(OUT/'build.log').read_text()},
    'developmentTrials':trials,
    'sourceSha256':source,'registrySha256':registry_hash,
    'outerCgroupMetrics':{n:Path('/sys/fs/cgroup',n).read_text() for n in ['memory.max','memory.peak','memory.events','pids.max','pids.peak','cpu.stat']},
    'disposal':{'processes':remaining,'uid1001Processes':uid_workers,'ownedCgroups':groups,
        'privateStoresBeforeOperatorRemoval':stores,'privateRootRemoved':not ROOT.exists(),
        'socketHandlesRemoved':len(sockets),'rawDiagnosticCopyWasPresent':debug_existed,
        'rawDiagnosticCopyRemoved':not debug.exists(),
        'method':'Privileged evaluation operator removed all inventoried stores after inspection, including failed automatic expiry copies. Not an automatic retention PASS.',
        'scope':'Controlled logical copies only; no physical erasure or unobserved backup guarantee.'},
    'verdict':{'REA_1_1':'PARTIAL','productionAndUnrestrictedAgents':'NO_GO','retentionAfterJanitorLoss':'FAIL',
        'mainChanged':False,'platformIntegration':False,'nativeProviders':'NOT_TESTED','fullSCA':'NOT_TESTED',
        'humanReview':'NOT_ATTESTED','realCredentials':'NOT_COLLECTED'}
}
raw=json.dumps(record,indent=2).encode()
(OUT/'janitor-export.json').write_bytes(raw)
compressed=gzip.compress(raw)
(OUT/'janitor-export.gz').write_bytes(compressed)
b64=base64.b64encode(compressed).decode()
(OUT/'janitor-export.b64').write_text(b64)
print(json.dumps({'bytes':len(raw),'gzipSha256':hashlib.sha256(compressed).hexdigest(),
    'base64Characters':len(b64),'chunks':(len(b64)+1799)//1800,
    'catalogue':catalogue['summary'],'regressions':regressions['summary'],
    'storesRemoved':len(stores),'storesWithFailedExpiry':sum(any(x['rowsBeforeOperatorDisposal'].values()) for x in stores)},indent=2))
